LanguageData.VME_TameInsectoid.label: pacify giant ant
LanguageData.VME_TameInsectoid.description: Uses learned behavior and a concentrated pheromone lure to pacify and tame a giant ant immediately.
LanguageData.VME_ConstructANest.label: establish ant nest
LanguageData.VME_ConstructANest.description: Establishes a controlled giant-ant nest that produces insect jelly. Performing a successful Call of the Colony ritual refreshes this ability's cooldown.
